title: Base Builder Grant Program
description: Grants of up to $5,000, plus GTM and product support, for teams actively building on Base with a live product that is getting used. Categories: prediction markets, launchpads for new crypto assets, DeFi 2.0, agents (commerce, x402, autonomous trading), new asset creation, and consumer apps focused on transaction growth. Reviewed in cohorts.
reward: Up to $5,000 in grants, plus GTM and product support
ideas: A live prediction market already getting used
An agent that pays per call with x402
A consumer app growing real transaction volume
rules: Rolling: apply to be included in the next cohort. No deadline is stated.
The Base team provides grants very selectively. The first step to be eligible is to integrate Builder Codes.
For builders exclusively building on Base right now.
You're past the idea stage, with a live product that's getting used.
For teams that need product, GTM, and launch help more than capital.

Categories: prediction markets; launchpads for new crypto assets; DeFi 2.0 (lending, borrowing, looping, yield generation, vaults, tokenized equities); agents (commerce, x402 implementations, autonomous trading); new asset creation; consumer apps focused on transaction growth.
Accepted teams unlock the Builder Stack: a pool of tools and credits (LLM inference, cloud, other dev infrastructure).
